title: Large Language Models and Deep Learning Fundamentals
description: Fundamentals of large language models and deep learning, including transformer implementation in Pytorch, training and inference, performance analysis, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural variations (ablations).

art.alt: Abstract transformer architecture rendered as concrete slabs, luminous matrix grids, and connected attention paths.

title: Resume Generator
description: A serverless resume generator utilizing the Anthropic messages API to create a structured markdown/html output that is rendered into a polished PDF resume, tailored to the input job description.

art.alt: Structured document pipeline transforming translucent inputs into a polished generated resume artifact.

title: Site Design and RAG Chatbot Integration
description: A review of the site creation process and the design and integration of a RAG-powered Generative AI Chatbot

art.alt: Brutalist website and retrieval architecture connected by luminous vector-search and chatbot signal paths.

title: The Regulatory Frontier: Colorado's ADMT Rules
description: A review of Colorado's ADMT Act and draft rules, with the written comment filed in the Attorney General's rulemaking.

art.alt: Illuminated glass records and a public comment in a concrete archive with a Colorado mountain relief.

title: Copilot Studio and Microsoft Stack Demo
description: A Power Platform demo that reads project managers' free-text notes and change-order justifications to assign cause and fault for cost overruns, graded at 91.1% against a synthetic ground truth.

art.alt: Glowing strands rise from a fiber conduit trench to link handwritten field notes, a change-order ledger, and a bar chart.

title: Data Playground
description: Interactive data exploration and visualization sandbox.
